snippet.title: Void Martyrs | Horror Game Awards SUMMER SHOWCASE TRAILER 2025
snippet.description:
Void Martyrs is a grimdark survival horror about a nun in a space suit. Inspired by games like Darkwood, Signalis, with the gameplay loop of Void Bastards.

Set in a future where the space race to the moon was won by the Church Space Program.

You're a novice nun that's been sent on a cosmic crusade to repel a biomechanical plague in a quarantined zone around Heaven's Gate. Explore abandoned drifting space-cathedrals and monasteries, to scavenge what resources you can. You'll need to balance your faith with your will to survive. Kill and be cursed, or stay faithful and find other ways to stay alive.

STEAM LINK: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3470850/Void_Martyrs/

#thehorrorgameawards #HorrorGamesShowcase
---
The Horror Game Awards started towards the end of 2022 as a Horror Game of the Year Award set up by two die hard horror game fans. Fourteen content creators made up that year’s jury. It was such a success that in 2023 the jury doubled in size and the awards expanded their scope.

The aim of the awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.

Website: https://thehorrorgameawards.com/
Merch: https://store.thehorrorgameawards.com/
